chunks: Hadith 1354 — Bakr ibn Muhammad narrated from him, peace be upon him, that he said:
"Whoever says, when he takes his sleeping place, three times:

All praise is due to Allah, Who is exalted and subdues. All praise is due to Allah, Who is hidden and thus fully aware. All praise is due to Allah, Who possesses dominion and thus has power. All praise is due to Allah, Who
and causes the living to die
and He is powerful over all things
he comes out from his sins as on the day his mother gave birth to him."

key_terms.الْحَمْدُ: praise and gratitude directed to Allah
key_terms.عَلَا: rose high; was exalted above all
key_terms.فَخَبَرَ: thus knew fully and was fully aware

ai.seo_question: What should one say before sleep for forgiveness of sins according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a bedtime dhikr praising Allah through His exaltedness, hidden knowledge, dominion, life-giving power, and absolute omnipotence. It promises that whoever recites it three times upon lying down to sleep will be cleansed of sins like a newborn.
